Chapter 318 - 318 Shopping; Asking For Help!

Chapter 318 - 318 Shopping; Asking for Help!

318 Shopping; Asking for Help!

Su Ningjing was very kind and had a good relationship with her former colleagues.

At that time, she had just finished her driver’s license examination. Her colleagues wanted to prevent her from forgetting how to drive, so they brought her along to familiarize herself with driving on the road for a period of time.

Today, under Lin Fan’s guidance and after circling the Coiling Dragon Villa a few times, it was no longer a problem for her to drive alone.

Hence, Lin Fan drove the Mercedes-Benz G-Class while Su Ningjing drove the Lamborghini Urus. They headed toward Washington Palace at an equal speed.

When they opened the door, the familiar smell of food wafted out from inside.

Ah Mei jumped up and down. “Brother and Sis are back! We can eat now!”

Lin Fan and Su Ningjing had just exercised for two hours. They were really hungry. They picked up a bowl and chopsticks and started eating.

After lunch.

Lin Fan said, “Grandma, Sis, you just moved in. You still lack some clothes and daily necessities, right? Ningjing and I will bring you guys to buy some now, okay?”

“I already have daily necessities,” the old lady said. “As for clothes, Ningjing knows my and Ah Mei’s size, so we won’t follow you guys.”

Ah Mei seemed eager to go, but she looked at the tired old lady.

“We can just stay at home.”

Regarding this…

Lin Fan did not force them. He wanted to take this opportunity to let Su Ningjing drive more alone.

After all, Su Ningjing had just started driving.

It was inevitable that she would be nervous if she were to directly drive Grandma and Ah Mei.

Thus, Lin Fan and Su Ningjing drove separately and arrived at KM Mall at a steady speed.

Although the clothes here were expensive, there were many styles suitable for men and women of all ages.

In addition, KM Mall belonged to Lin Fan. By visiting his own mall, it could be said that he was giving his tenants some benefits.

Since there was no need to try the clothes, he only needed to get them in the right sizes.

Therefore, it was very convenient to purchase them.

At the same time, 88 red packets appeared on Lin Fan’s phone.

Luckily, KM Mall provided delivery services. Otherwise, Lin Fan really would not have been able to carry so many things.

When Lin Fan and Su Ningjing arrived at the underground carpark, Lin Fan suddenly remembered… His phone seemed to be in one of the shopping bags.

If it was something else, Lin Fan could choose not to take it now.

However, his phone was where he collected the daily red packets.

He naturally could not abandon it.

Wait for me in the car,” he said to Su Ningjing. “I put my phone in one of the shopping bags.”

“Alright,” Su Ningjing said.

Then, Lin Fan took the elevator again.

Su Ningjing slowly walked toward the parking lot.

After a while, she saw her car…

At this moment, a gentle voice suddenly sounded from behind.

“Beautiful lady, I’m sorry to disturb you.”

When Su Ningjing heard the voice, she could not help but turn around to look.

The man in Eddie Bauer clothes was immediately attracted by Su Ningjing’s side profile.

At this moment, when he saw Su Ningjing’s face, his heart started to beat wildly.

Beautiful!

She was too beautiful!

Pure and beautiful!

This feeling… She was like a fairy who had descended from the sky.

“Excuse me, what’s the matter?” Su Ningjing asked curiously.

She sounded good!

Even her voice was so pleasant!

He had to get her!

The man tried his best to suppress the excitement in his heart. Then, he said in an embarrassed tone, “Uhh… I just spent one million yuan to buy a BMW X5. The technology is not very good. The front is a little narrow, and there are cars on both sides. Can you help me drive it out?”

As he spoke, he took out his car keys and pressed them gently.

Sure enough, the headlights of a brand-new BMW X5 flashed slightly.

He first pointed out that he had a million-dollar luxury car.

Then, he used a good attitude to ask Su Ningjing for help.

It was really easy to get help in this way.

The man had already made a plan in his heart.

He would use this as an excuse to add Su Ningjing on WeChat and treat her to a meal later…

In the man’s heart, he had already begun to fantasize about holding hands with Su Ningjing and their future life together. An invisible smile appeared on his face.

However, before Su Ningjing could respond, footsteps could be heard from afar.

It was Lin Fan.

He grabbed Su Ningjing’s slender waist with one hand.

Seeing this…

The man’s pupils constricted slightly. Jealousy, hatred, and other complicated expressions flashed across his face.

It was not easy for him to meet a beauty. Why?!

However, immediately after…

His eyes shifted slightly again.

If they were just a couple, perhaps he still had a chance.

After all, he had a million-dollar luxury car!

Therefore, the man tried his best to put on a calm tone and asked, “And this is?”

“I’m her boyfriend,” Lin Fan said.

Sure enough, it was just a casual relationship between a man and a woman. The man was slightly happy.

“You know my girlfriend?” Lin Fan asked again.

“We just met,” Su Ningjing said.

Then, Su Ningjing roughly recounted their conversation.

How smart was Lin Fan? He instantly understood the other party’s thoughts.

He pointed at the BMW X5 in front of him and said, “Is that the car?”

The man raised his head slightly and said, “Yes.”

He looked extremely smug.

It was as if he was saying, ‘That’s my million-dollar luxury car!’

Lin Fan said, “Ningjing, he said that your car is making it difficult for him to drive out. In that case, drive your car out first.”

“Alright,” Su Ningjing replied.

As soon as she finished speaking, she took out the car keys to the Lamborghini Urus and pressed them gently.

Then, she opened the car door, got in, and drove out.

Seeing this…

The man was slightly stunned. “L-Lamborghini Urus…”

Obviously, he had some understanding of cars.

Lin Fan saw that the man was standing there without any intention of moving and said, “You still can’t drive your car out?”

Hence, he opened the door of the Mercedes-Benz G beside his car and drove the car out.

“M-Mercedes-Benz G…” The man could not help but say again.

Lin Fan rolled down the window and asked, “How is it? Do you have enough space now? Do you want me to help drive your car out?”

The man’s face instantly turned red.

He had bragged for a long time that he had a million-dollar luxury car, but what was the result?

In the end, this person owned a top-notch Mercedes-Benz G worth more than two million.

There was also the Lamborghini Urus which was worth more than three million.

The man only felt that he was a fool.

At this moment, he only wanted to leave this place as soon as possible.

Therefore, the man did not answer Lin Fan. He lowered his head and walked into the BMW X5, stepping on the accelerator.

However, he accidentally knocked into a pillar in front of him.

After the man got out of the car, he looked at the broken headlights and the bent hood, his heart bleeding.

“I just bought this!”
